n25465.name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.IsProper.integral_bdd_mul
n25465.type_full:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {𝓑 𝓧 : MeasurableSpace X} {π : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel X X} {f g : X → Real} {x₀ : X}
  [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel π],
  LE.le 𝓑 𝓧 →
    π.IsProper →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable f (π x₀) →
        MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable g →
          (Exists fun C => And (GT.gt C 0) (∀ (x : X), LE.le (norm (g x)) C)) →
            Eq (MeasureTheory.integral (π x₀) fun x => HMul.hMul (g x) (f x))
              (HMul.hMul (g x₀) (MeasureTheory.integral (π x₀) fun x => f x))

∀ {X : Type u_1} {𝓑 𝓧 : MeasurableSpace X} {π : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel X X} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X}

n25476.name: Specification.IsPremodifier.isModifier_div
n25476.type_full:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {mE : MeasurableSpace E} {ρ : Finset S → (S → E) → ENNReal},
  Specification.IsPremodifier ρ →
    ∀ (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν],
      (∀ (Λ : Finset S) (σ : S → E),
          And (LT.lt 0 (MeasureTheory.lintegral (((Specification.isssd ν) Λ) σ) fun x => ρ Λ x))
            (LT.lt (MeasureTheory.lintegral (((Specification.isssd ν) Λ) σ) fun x => ρ Λ x) Top.top)) →
        (Specification.isssd ν).IsModifier fun Λ σ =>
          HDiv.hDiv (ρ Λ σ) (MeasureTheory.lintegral (((Specification.isssd ν) Λ) σ) fun x => ρ Λ x)

n25484.name: Specification.isModifier_iff_ae_comm
n25484.type_full:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {mE : MeasurableSpace E} {γ : Specification S E} {ρ : Finset S → (S → E) → ENNReal}
  [inst : DecidableEq S] [γ.IsMarkov],
  γ.IsProper →
    γ.IsIndep →
      (∀ (Λ : Finset S) (η : S → E), Eq (MeasureTheory.lintegral ((γ Λ) η) fun ζ => ρ Λ ζ) 1) →
        Iff (γ.IsModifier ρ)
          (And (∀ (Λ : Finset S), Measurable (ρ Λ))
            (∀ ⦃Λ₁ Λ₂ : Finset S⦄,
              LE.le Λ₁ Λ₂ →
                ∀ (η₁ : S → E),
                  Filter.Eventually
                    (fun η₂ =>
                      Filter.Eventually
                        (fun z => Eq (HMul.hMul (ρ Λ₂ z.1) (ρ Λ₁ z.2)) (HMul.hMul (ρ Λ₂ z.2) (ρ Λ₁ z.1)))
                        (MeasureTheory.ae (((γ Λ₁) η₂).prod ((γ Λ₁) η₂))))
                    (MeasureTheory.ae ((γ (sdiff Λ₂ Λ₁)) η₁))))

n25485.name: Specification.isModifier_iff_ae_eq
n25485.type_full:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {mE : MeasurableSpace E} {γ : Specification S E} {ρ : Finset S → (S → E) → ENNReal}
  [γ.IsMarkov],
  γ.IsProper →
    Iff (γ.IsModifier ρ)
      (And (∀ (Λ : Finset S), Measurable (ρ Λ))
        (∀ ⦃Λ₁ Λ₂ : Finset S⦄,
          LE.le Λ₁ Λ₂ →
            ∀ (η : S → E),
              (MeasureTheory.ae ((γ Λ₂) η)).EventuallyEq (ρ Λ₂) fun ω =>
                HMul.hMul (ρ Λ₁ ω) (MeasureTheory.lintegral ((γ Λ₁) ω) fun ζ => ρ Λ₂ ζ)))
